messages:
ashley: Heads-up — after the 2.3.1 runtime patch I still see a weird tail-latency bump on the small-batch smoke job when running on our Ampere pool. Can someone grab a short nsys + torch.profiler capture?

devin: I can take it. Which job and what exact config should I run? quick patch repro or prod?

ashley: Start with the nightly benchmark image on staging (tag: rni/nightly:2026-03-15). Repro is with batch_size=4, seq=1024, kv-cache enabled. Keep it short (20 tokens) but do a couple of warmups.

sam: FYI the regression looked like a spike in kernel launch stalls + a KV cache miss flood on a couple of shards. Might be tensor-namespace alignment after the patch.

ashley: Good note — include one hot run with kv_warmup=True and one cold run kv_warmup=False so we can compare.

devin: Ok will capture. Quick nsys command I use:
```
nsys profile --trace=cuda,osrt,torch --sample=none -o /tmp/devin_trace --force \
  --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi \
  --stats=true python -u tools/bench/run_infer.py --model rni/llama-7b --batch 4 --seq 1024 --tokens 20
```
I'll redact keys and upload to s3/rni-profiling/devin/2464801234/ after.

tina: For torch.profiler snippet, add this around the forward call so we get operator-level breakdown: 
```
with torch.profiler.profile(
    activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU, torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA],
    record_shapes=True,
    with_stack=True,
) as prof:
    with torch.profiler.record_function("inference_step"):
        model(input_ids)
prof.export_chrome_trace("/tmp/devin_torchprof.json")
```
Also capture `nvprof` style metrics via nsys --stats.

devin: Thanks — will include both and keep logs. Any redaction checklist?

ashley: Yes, please scrub these before uplink: all S3 keys, internal hostnames, user tokens, and the first 2 prompt texts. Use the redaction script at infra/tools/trace_scrub.py — it strips envs and ip addresses. Mark which kernels look suspicious.

perf-bot: Reminder: upload policy requires a short metadata file with fields: run_id, image_tag, gpu_type, kernel_version, kv_warmup, and top3-suspect-kernels. You can paste it as a comment if you don't want to create a file.

devin: Uploading artifacts now. nsys file is 1.2GB (trimmed), torchprof json is 8MB. Put a stub meta: {run_id: 2464801234, image: rni/nightly:2026-03-15, gpu: A100-80G, kv_warmup: false}.

sam: Can you also attach the `dmesg` tail and `nvidia-smi -q`? Helps rule out driver hiccups.

devin: added dmesg and nvidia-smi output to the upload. Link: s3://rni-profiling/devin/2464801234/ (private).

ashley: Great. Can you quick-share the top 5 CUDA kernels (name + avg latency) you see from the nsys summary?

devin: Top5: 
1) aten::matmul_kernel — 42.3us avg
2) cuBLASLtMatmul — 31.8us avg
3) aten::layer_norm_forward — 18.5us
4) memcpyHtoDAsync — 12.1us
5) aten::gelu — 9.3us
The matmul jumps on cold runs.

sam: That matmul jump with cold KV makes me think about an alignment change in the fused matmul kernel selection path. I'll diff the kernel-selection logic in the runtime patch.

tina: I'll run a small reproducer with cudnn disabled to rule out vendor autotuner noise. Also, check if quantization branch is hitting a different code path (fp16 vs amp kernel).

devin: Quick q: do we want a flamegraph export? I can run torchprof -> speedscope and flameplot.

ashley: Yes please — a flamegraph makes it easier to see stacking. If you can generate a speedscope json that'd be ideal and drop it next to traces.

perf-bot: Upload complete. Artifacts: nsys (/tmp/devin_trace.nsys-rep), torchprof (/tmp/devin_torchprof.json), speedscope (/tmp/devin_speedscope.json), meta.yml. Link: s3://rni-profiling/devin/2464801234/ (permission: eng-runtime + perf eng).

sam: I'll pull and run the mini-bisect: toggle the kernel selector change in the runtime diff and re-run the same capture (only 2 warmups + 10 tokens to keep time). If that's the culprit we can revert the selection change and schedule a patch.

ashley: Thanks all. Devin — once you confirm the speedscope and summary are uploaded I'll add this to the perf-regressions board with the artifacts link. :thumbsup:

devin: Confirmed and added a short note in the upload meta about the observed matmul skew. Leaving it open for sam to bisect.

ashley: Awesome. If anybody wants to join the bisect ping @sam — we'll sync async here.

sam: Pinged on calendar for a quick 20-min pairing tomorrow if needed.

ashley: Closing thread when bisect result is posted. Thanks everyone. :wave:
